video_timeline.note: mix spans the whole CaseFilm composition; body (narration+cues) offset by lead so it aligns with the burned captions + figures

timeline.timing_source: narration_index chunk durations (measured per-chunk audio when present, else estimate); SFX placed by token position within the owning chunk; whole body shifted by lead

music.role: per-chapter ducked musical bed (sidechained by VO) + hook/opening intro fill + endcard outro fill

ambience.role: distinct constant location bed per chapter (audible; NOT sidechained -> capped duck)

sfx.role: narration-timed one-shots at real words + chapter cuts (cue times are body-local; add timeline.lead_sec for absolute)
sfx.transient_bed_removed_note: The former onset-density filler bed (326 meaningless tick/blip/whoosh hits placed on a fixed cadence to game the acceptance onset floor) was REMOVED (EP32 owner reject 2026-07-06). SFX are now ONLY the script's designed (SFX:) cues + chapter cuts at real narrated beats; the gate rewards distinct SFX files + beds, not raw transient count.

mux.note: This WAV is the ONLY audio in the final deliverable; the video is muxed with -map 0:v -map 1:a so the render carries exactly this mix.

unmapped_sfx.phrase: a gentle outro resolving on the musical cadence

swells.phrase: a soft human room-tone under the map
a held tone that opens upward
echoing footsteps in a stone hall
a low, personal pulse under the bench

sfx_cues.phrase: a sheet of paper tearing. No music
a page turn as the deed is smoothed flat
a soft tick as each fee chip lands
a single low boom — a close, personal heartbeat of bass
a drawer slides shut with a click
a bright clink as the $40,000 column locks in
a heavy slam on "kept all forty thousand."
three dividing ticks as the surplus splits three ways
a soft echoing blip as the second timeline mirrors the first
a paper rustle as the one-dollar slip changes hands
a clean, warm confirm — a bright clink as the green banner mask-reveals
scattered data-blips as dots bloom nationwide
many data-blips as the column multiplies
three settling stone blocks — a low thud as each brick lands
a reverse-time whoosh as the timeline runs backward
a quill scratch — a paper rustle as the clause underlines itself
a long traveling whoosh as the line sweeps 1215 to the modern office
a stone crack — a hard impact
the card's bricks tumbling in a low boom
a long forward whoosh sweeping through the centuries
a quieter, secondary clink as the concurrence card rises
a soft whoosh as the wave of green sweeps the map
a series of clean switch-ons — soft ticks as each node turns green

ffmpeg.mixing: narration(front) + music(sidechain-ducked) + ambience(constant audible bed + swell automation) + sfx(one-shots), two-pass loudnorm I=-14
